title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection | Antique Pewter | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter | Allied Brass, Antique Pewter
description:
Add convenient towel storage with a wall mount towel ring crafted from solid brass and sized at 6-inch diameter for everyday hand towels in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. Part of the Foxtrot collection, this round ring complements transitional bathroom hardware and helps keep towels within easy reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, streamlined look
- Includes towel ring and all installation hardware
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Foxtrot collection

Specs:
- Product type: Towel ring (round)
- Diameter: 6 inches
- Projection: 2 inches
- Overall size (L x W x H): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
